title.en: Chinalco sets up corporate treasury centre in Hong Kong
title.zh_hant: 中鋁在港設立企業財資中心 作集團境外資金管理平台
title.zh_hans: 中铝在港设立企业财资中心 作集团境外资金管理平台

summary.en: Invest Hong Kong announced on October 23 that Aluminum Corporation of China (Chinalco) has set up Chinalco Treasury Management Limited in Hong Kong as its offshore fund management platform, centralising overseas fund management and handling offshore financing, foreign exchange and interest rate risk management. InvestHK Director-General Alpha Lau said Hong Kong, as the world's largest offshore renminbi hub, offers cross-border renminbi settlement, multi-currency treasury management and risk hedging capabilities. Chinalco chief financial officer Wang Xin said the platform will help the group manage its global funds in an integrated way and improve capital efficiency as its overseas business expands.
summary.zh_hant: 投資推廣署10月23日宣布，中國鋁業集團（中鋁）已在港設立「中鋁集團財資管理有限公司」，作為集團境外資金管理平台，集中管理境外資金，並處理境外融資、匯率及利率風險管理。投資推廣署署長劉凱旋表示，香港作為全球最大離岸人民幣樞紐，可提供跨境人民幣結算、多幣種資金管理及風險對沖能力。中鋁財務總監王欣表示，隨集團海外業務擴大，需要高效平台統籌境外資金管理，香港外匯市場規模全球第四，有助集團一體化管理全球資金，提升資金運營效率。
summary.zh_hans: 投资推广署10月23日宣布，中国铝业集团（中铝）已在港设立「中铝集团财资管理有限公司」，作为集团境外资金管理平台，集中管理境外资金，并处理境外融资、汇率及利率风险管理。投资推广署署长刘凯旋表示，香港作为全球最大离岸人民币枢纽，可提供跨境人民币结算、多币种资金管理及风险对冲能力。中铝财务总监王欣表示，随集团海外业务扩大，需要高效平台统筹境外资金管理，香港外汇市场规模全球第四，有助集团一体化管理全球资金，提升资金运营效率。

title.en: Red fire danger warning in force
title.zh_hant: 紅色火災危險警告生效
title.zh_hans: 红色火灾危险警告生效

summary.en: The Hong Kong Observatory issued the red fire danger warning at 6:01am on October 23. The fire danger situation is rated red, meaning the danger is extreme, and hillsides and the countryside are at very high risk of hill fires. Members of the public planning to go to the countryside are advised to bring cooked food for picnics and to take all measures to prevent hill fires. Lighting fires illegally in the countryside carries a maximum penalty of a HK$25,000 fine and one year's imprisonment.
summary.zh_hant: 天文台今日（10月23日）早上6時01分發出紅色火災危險警告，火災危險情況屬紅色，火險極高，郊區極易發生山火。呼籲計劃到郊區的市民帶備已煮熟食物野餐，並採取一切措施防止山火。在郊區非法燃點山火，罰款25,000元及監禁一年。
summary.zh_hans: 天文台今日（10月23日）早上6时01分发出红色火灾危险警告，火灾危险情况属红色，火险极高，郊区极易发生山火。呼吁计划到郊区的市民带备已煮熟食物野餐，并采取一切措施防止山火。在郊区非法燃点山火，罚款25,000元及监禁一年。

title.en: Global Governance Forum opens in Xiong'an; Wang Yi to deliver keynote
title.zh_hant: 全球治理論壇今日雄安開幕 王毅發表主旨演講
title.zh_hans: 全球治理论坛今日雄安开幕 王毅发表主旨演讲

summary.en: The 2026 Global Governance Forum (Xiong'an) opens today (October 23) and runs for three days in Xiong'an New Area, Hebei, under the theme of rebuilding confidence and cooperation amid global governance reform. Hosted by the Chinese People's Institute of Foreign Affairs, the forum is expected to draw confirmed representatives from politics, academia, business, media and youth sectors from nearly 100 countries, covering UN reform, climate change, artificial intelligence and multilateral trade. China's foreign ministry announced on October 21 that Politburo member and foreign minister Wang Yi will attend today's opening ceremony and deliver the keynote speech.
summary.zh_hant: 「2026全球治理論壇（雄安）」今日起一連三日（10月23至25日）在河北雄安新區舉行，主題圍繞重建信心與合作、變革世界中的全球治理改革與完善。論壇由中國人民外交學會主辦，主辦方表示已有來自近100個國家的政界、學界、商界、媒體及青年代表確認出席，議題涵蓋聯合國改革、氣候變化、人工智能及多邊貿易。外交部10月21日宣布，中共中央政治局委員、外交部長王毅將出席今日開幕式並發表主旨演講。
summary.zh_hans: 「2026全球治理论坛（雄安）」今日起一连三日（10月23至25日）在河北雄安新区举行，主题围绕重建信心与合作、变革世界中的全球治理改革与完善。论坛由中国人民外交学会主办，主办方表示已有来自近100个国家的政界、学界、商界、媒体及青年代表确认出席，议题涵盖联合国改革、气候变化、人工智能及多边贸易。外交部10月21日宣布，中共中央政治局委员、外交部长王毅将出席今日开幕式并发表主旨演讲。

title.en: Anthropic IPO stands alone as AI market jitters sideline others
title.zh_hant: AI 市場動盪拖累同業押後上市 Anthropic 堅持下月 IPO
title.zh_hans: AI 市场动荡拖累同业押后上市 Anthropic 坚持下月 IPO

summary.en: A Reuters analysis on October 22 says Anthropic is the only tech firm still pressing ahead with its fall IPO schedule, planning to go public in mid-November after making its prospectus public as early as late October, with institutional marketing expected in the week of November 9. Other AI infrastructure and data-centre companies have delayed their listings amid rising interest rates, a selloff in AI operators such as CoreWeave, and questions about the sustainability of AI capital spending. The analysis notes that other issuers are reluctant to compete with Anthropic for institutional investors' attention and capital, viewing the firm as one of the few exposures long-term investors cannot ignore.
summary.zh_hant: 路透10月22日分析指，秋季科技IPO檔期只剩Anthropic一家按計劃推進，預計最快10月底公開招股書，11月9日當周開始向機構投資者路演，11月中旬上市，市場憧憬估值或達1.5萬億美元。其他AI基建及數據中心公司紛紛押後上市，面對利率上升、CoreWeave等AI運營商股債遭拋售，以及市場質疑AI資本開支可持續性，令估值受壓。分析指其他發行人都不想與Anthropic爭機構投資者注意力及資金，不少長線投資者仍看好Anthropic前景。
summary.zh_hans: 路透10月22日分析指，秋季科技IPO档期只剩Anthropic一家按计划推进，预计最快10月底公开招股书，11月9日当周开始向机构投资者路演，11月中旬上市，市场憧憬估值或达1.5万亿美元。其他AI基建及数据中心公司纷纷押后上市，面对利率上升、CoreWeave等AI运营商股债遭抛售，以及市场质疑AI资本开支可持续性，令估值受压。分析指其他发行人都不想与Anthropic争机构投资者注意力及资金，不少长线投资者仍看好Anthropic前景。

title.en: HKSAR government condemns UK's six-monthly report on Hong Kong
title.zh_hant: 特區政府強烈譴責英國所謂《香港半年報告》
title.zh_hans: 特区政府强烈谴责英国所谓《香港半年报告》

summary.en: The Hong Kong SAR government on October 23 strongly condemned and firmly rejected the United Kingdom's so-called 'Six-monthly Report on Hong Kong: January to June 2026', accusing it of untruthful remarks, slander and smears against the city. A spokesman stressed that the core of the Sino-British Joint Declaration is China's resumption of sovereignty over Hong Kong, and that Britain has no sovereignty, jurisdiction or right of supervision over the city after its return, urging London to stop long-arm jurisdiction at once. The statement rebutted allegations on national security laws, press freedom and the case of Lai Chee-ying — noting the court's 855-page reasons for verdict — and pointed out that Britain itself has at least 14 national security laws and arrested nearly 4,000 people under national security and counter-terrorism laws as of June 2026.
summary.zh_hant: 特區政府10月23日發表聲明，強烈譴責並堅決反駁英國發表的所謂《香港半年報告：2026年1月至6月》，批評報告對香港作出不實言論、污衊和抹黑。發言人強調《中英聯合聲明》的核心是中國恢復對香港行使主權，英國在香港回歸後對港並無主權、治權和監督權，促請英方立即停止長臂管轄。聲明逐點回應有關國安法例、新聞自由及黎智英案的指控，指出法庭就黎智英案頒下855頁判詞理由；又反指英國自身至少有14部國安法律，截至2026年6月按國安及反恐法例拘捕近4,000人，斥責英方雙重標準。
summary.zh_hans: 特区政府10月23日发表声明，强烈谴责并坚决反驳英国发表的所谓《香港半年报告：2026年1月至6月》，批评报告对香港作出不实言论、污蔑和抹黑。发言人强调《中英联合声明》的核心是中国恢复对香港行使主权，英国在香港回归后对港并无主权、治权和监督权，促请英方立即停止长臂管辖。声明逐点回应有关国安法例、新闻自由及黎智英案的指控，指出法庭就黎智英案颁下855页判词理由；又反指英国自身至少有14部国安法律，截至2026年6月按国安及反恐法例拘捕近4,000人，斥责英方双重标准。

title.en: Customs seizes HK$4.6 million of illicit cigarettes and counterfeit goods in Chung Ying Street raid
title.zh_hant: 海關中英街搗私煙冒牌貨倉　檢值460萬拘一女店員
title.zh_hans: 海关中英街捣私烟冒牌货仓　检值460万拘一女店员

summary.en: Hong Kong Customs on October 22 mounted a special operation in Chung Ying Street, Sha Tau Kok, seizing about 720,000 suspected illicit cigarettes and around 2,700 suspected counterfeit goods with an estimated market value of about HK$4.6 million. Officers found a retail shop selling suspected illicit cigarettes and uncovered the haul in the shop and three adjoining rooms, including suspected counterfeit perfume, beauty products, belts and handbags. The duty potential of the cigarettes was about HK$2.4 million. A 50-year-old local saleswoman was arrested and investigations are continuing, with further arrests not ruled out.
summary.zh_hant: 香港海關10月22日在沙頭角中英街採取特別執法行動，檢獲約72萬支懷疑私煙及約2,700件懷疑冒牌物品，估計市值共約460萬元。關員發現一間零售店舖售賣懷疑私煙，入內調查後在店內及其三個相連房間檢獲上述物品，包括懷疑冒牌香水、美容產品、皮帶及手袋；懷疑私煙應課稅值約240萬元。海關拘捕一名50歲本地女售貨員，案件仍在調查，不排除有更多人被捕。
summary.zh_hans: 香港海关10月22日在沙头角中英街采取特别执法行动，检获约72万支怀疑私烟及约2,700件怀疑冒牌物品，估计市值共约460万元。关员发现一间零售店铺售卖怀疑私烟，入内调查后在店内及其三个相连房间检获上述物品，包括怀疑冒牌香水、美容产品、皮带及手袋；怀疑私烟应课税值约240万元。海关拘捕一名50岁本地女售货员，案件仍在调查，不排除有更多人被捕。

title.en: Marine departments stage Oilex and HNS pollution response drills off Lamma Island
title.zh_hant: 海事處環保署南丫島海面舉行海上污染應變演習
title.zh_hans: 海事处环保署南丫岛海面举行海上污染应变演习

summary.en: Government departments on the morning of October 22 staged the annual marine pollution joint response exercises, codenamed 'Oilex 2026' and 'HNS 2026', in the waters off Mo Tat Wan on Lamma Island. The scenario involved an oil tanker colliding with a container vessel, spilling fuel oil, with five containers of Maleic anhydride falling overboard. An oil pollution combat team deployed floating barrier booms around the tanker, while pollution control vessels and a Government Flying Service helicopter sprayed dispersant and oil skimmers were put to work; a shoreline cleaning team drilled at the non-gazetted beach of Mo Tat Wan. The Fire Services Department and other units handled the hazardous containers. The exercises were coordinated by the Marine Department and the Environmental Protection Department, with the Police, the Government Laboratory, the Civil Aid Service and oil companies taking part.
summary.zh_hant: 多個政府部門10月22日早上在南丫島模達灣對開海面，舉行年度海上污染聯合應變演習「Oilex 2026」及「HNS 2026」。演習假設一艘油輪與貨櫃船相撞，燃油洩漏，另有五個載有順丁烯二酸酐的貨櫃墮海。油污戰鬥隊在油輪四周佈放圍油欄，污染控制船隻及政府飛行服務隊直升機噴灑化油劑，並出動吸油機；岸線清潔隊在模達灣非刊憲泳灘演練清理工作。消防處等單位負責處理危險品貨櫃。演習由海事處及環境保護署統籌，警隊、政府化驗所、民安隊及多間油公司亦有參與。
summary.zh_hans: 多个政府部门10月22日早上在南丫岛模达湾对开海面，举行年度海上污染联合应变演习「Oilex 2026」及「HNS 2026」。演习假设一艘油轮与货柜船相撞，燃油泄漏，另有五个载有顺丁烯二酸酐的货柜堕海。油污战斗队在油轮四周布放围油栏，污染控制船只及政府飞行服务队直升机喷洒化油剂，并出动吸油机；岸线清洁队在模达湾非刊宪泳滩演练清理工作。消防处等单位负责处理危险品货柜。演习由海事处及环境保护署统筹，警队、政府化验所、民安队及多间油公司亦有参与。

title.en: Food safety watchdog finds malachite green in bluefin tuna sample
title.zh_hant: 食安中心驗出藍鰭吞拿魚樣本含孔雀石綠
title.zh_hans: 食安中心验出蓝鳍吞拿鱼样本含孔雀石绿

summary.en: The Centre for Food Safety has detected malachite green at 1.74 parts per billion in a bluefin tuna sample taken at import level. Malachite green is an industrial dye once used to treat fish infections and has been banned for use in food animals in many countries. Hong Kong law prohibits any malachite green in food, with offenders liable to a HK$50,000 fine and six months' imprisonment. The CFS has notified the importer concerned and is tracing the source and distribution of the product as investigations continue.
summary.zh_hant: 食物安全中心在入口層面抽驗一個藍鰭吞拿魚樣本，驗出含孔雀石綠，含量為十億分之1.74。孔雀石綠是一種工業染料，曾用作治療魚類感染，多國已禁止用於食用動物。本港法例不容許食物含有孔雀石綠，違者可被罰款5萬元及監禁6個月。食安中心已通知有關進口商，正追查有關產品的來源及分銷情況，調查仍然繼續。
summary.zh_hans: 食物安全中心在入口层面抽验一个蓝鳍吞拿鱼样本，验出含孔雀石绿，含量为十亿分之1.74。孔雀石绿是一种工业染料，曾用作治疗鱼类感染，多国已禁止用于食用动物。本港法例不容许食物含有孔雀石绿，违者可被罚款5万元及监禁6个月。食安中心已通知有关进口商，正追查有关产品的来源及分销情况，调查仍然继续。

title.en: All 116 Japanese food samples pass radiation tests, government says
title.zh_hant: 116個日本進口食品樣本輻射檢測全數合格
title.zh_hans: 116个日本进口食品样本辐射检测全数合格

summary.en: All 116 samples of Japanese imported food tested between noon on October 21 and noon on October 22 passed radiation safety checks, the government announced. Following Japan's discharge of nuclear-contaminated water from Fukushima, the Director of Food and Environmental Hygiene issued a food safety order banning aquatic products, sea salt and seaweed from 10 prefectures — Tokyo, Fukushima, Ibaraki, Miyagi, Chiba, Gunma, Tochigi, Niigata, Nagano and Saitama. The Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department also tested 50 samples of local catch, all satisfactory, and the Observatory found no abnormalities in stepped-up monitoring of local waters. Since August 24, 2023, a total of 269,461 Japanese import samples and 57,410 local catch samples have been tested, all passing.
summary.zh_hant: 政府公布，10月21日中午至10月22日中午抽驗的116個日本進口食品樣本，輻射水平全部未超標準。因應日本排放福島核污染水，食物環境衞生署署長已發出食物安全命令，禁止10個都縣（東京、福島、茨城、宮城、千葉、群馬、栃木、新潟、長野、埼玉）的水產、海鹽及海藻進口。漁農自然護理署亦抽驗50個本地漁獲樣本，全部合格；天文台加強本地水域監測，未發現異常。自2023年8月24日至今，當局累計抽驗日本進口食品269,461個樣本及本地漁獲57,410個樣本，全部合格。
summary.zh_hans: 政府公布，10月21日中午至10月22日中午抽验的116个日本进口食品样本，辐射水平全部未超标准。因应日本排放福岛核污染水，食物环境卫生署署长已发出食物安全命令，禁止10个都县（东京、福岛、茨城、宫城、千叶、群马、栃木、新潟、长野、埼玉）的水产、海盐及海藻进口。渔农自然护理署亦抽验50个本地渔获样本，全部合格；天文台加强本地水域监测，未发现异常。自2023年8月24日至今，当局累计抽验日本进口食品269,461个样本及本地渔获57,410个样本，全部合格。

title.en: Big Wave Bay Beach closed for shark net repairs as red flags fly over big waves
title.zh_hant: 大浪灣泳灘維修防鯊網暫封　多泳灘因大浪掛紅旗
title.zh_hans: 大浪湾泳滩维修防鲨网暂封　多泳滩因大浪挂红旗

summary.en: The Leisure and Cultural Services Department announced that Big Wave Bay Beach in Southern District, Hong Kong Island, is temporarily closed from October 22 until further notice for shark prevention net maintenance, and urged swimmers not to swim there. Earlier in the day, red flags were hoisted over Stanley Main Beach, Shek O Beach and Big Wave Bay Beach in Southern District, as well as Trio Beach, Hap Mun Bay Beach (Half Moon Bay), Silverstrand Beach and Clear Water Bay Second Beach in Sai Kung, due to big waves.
summary.zh_hant: 康樂及文化事務署宣布，港島南區大浪灣泳灘由10月22日起暫時封閉，直至另行通告，以維修防鯊網，呼籲泳客切勿前往游泳。同日較早前，康文署因大浪，在港島南區赤柱正灘、石澳泳灘及大浪灣泳灘，以及西貢區三星灣泳灘、廈門灣泳灘（半月灣）、銀線灣泳灘及清水灣第二泳灘懸掛紅旗，呼籲泳客切勿游泳。
summary.zh_hans: 康乐及文化事务署宣布，港岛南区大浪湾泳滩由10月22日起暂时封闭，直至另行通告，以维修防鲨网，呼吁泳客切勿前往游泳。同日较早前，康文署因大浪，在港岛南区赤柱正滩、石澳泳滩及大浪湾泳滩，以及西贡区三星湾泳滩、厦门湾泳滩（半月湾）、银线湾泳滩及清水湾第二泳滩悬挂红旗，呼吁泳客切勿游泳。

title.en: Beijing executive vice-mayor Xia Linmao placed under corruption probe
title.zh_hant: 北京市常務副市長夏林茂涉嚴重違紀違法受查
title.zh_hans: 北京市常务副市长夏林茂涉严重违纪违法受查

summary.en: China's top anti-graft bodies announced on October 22 that Xia Linmao, 56, a Standing Committee member of the Beijing municipal Communist Party committee and the city's executive vice-mayor, is under investigation for suspected serious violations of discipline and law. Xia, an alternate member of the 20th Communist Party Central Committee, oversees the municipal government's daily operations. Caixin reported he is the 56th centrally-administered cadre to come under investigation this year. The announcement comes just days before the 20th Central Committee's fifth plenary session opens on October 26.
summary.zh_hant: 中央紀委國家監委10月22日宣布，北京市委常委、常務副市長夏林茂（56歲）涉嫌嚴重違紀違法，正接受紀律審查和監察調查。夏林茂是中共二十屆中央委員會候補委員，負責市政府日常運作。財新報道指，他是今年以來第56名被公開調查的中管幹部。通報時機正值中共二十屆五中全會10月26日召開前夕。
summary.zh_hans: 中央纪委国家监委10月22日宣布，北京市委常委、常务副市长夏林茂（56岁）涉嫌严重违纪违法，正接受纪律审查和监察调查。夏林茂是中共二十届中央委员会候补委员，负责市政府日常运作。财新报道指，他是今年以来第56名被公开调查的中管干部。通报时机正值中共二十届五中全会10月26日召开前夕。

source.name: 國務院港澳辦（新華社稿）

title.en: Xi hails Long March spirit at 90th anniversary ceremony in Beijing
title.zh_hant: 紀念紅軍長征勝利90周年大會北京舉行　習近平發表講話
title.zh_hans: 纪念红军长征胜利90周年大会北京举行　习近平发表讲话

summary.en: A ceremony marking the 90th anniversary of the victory of the Red Army's Long March was held at the Great Hall of the People in Beijing on the morning of October 22, with President Xi Jinping delivering a keynote speech. Xi said that 'only by remembering history can we open up the future', calling on the whole Party to carry forward the spirit of the Long March on the new Long March of the new era. All attendees stood in silent tribute to the martyrs of the Long March and the revolutionary struggle. Xi stressed that the Party's correct leadership and Mao Zedong's core position were key to victory. The 1934–1936 Long March crossed more than 10 provinces. About 3,000 people attended, including Li Qiang, Zhao Leji, Wang Huning, Cai Qi, Ding Xuexiang, Li Xi and Han Zheng.
summary.zh_hant: 紀念中國工農紅軍長征勝利90周年大會10月22日上午在北京人民大會堂舉行，習近平出席並發表重要講話。習近平指出「只有銘記歷史，才能開創未來」，號召全黨大力弘揚偉大長征精神，走好新時代的長征路。全體與會者起立，為長征途中和革命鬥爭中犧牲的先烈默哀。習近平強調，黨的正確領導和毛澤東的核心地位是長征勝利的關鍵。1934年10月至1936年10月，紅軍長征轉戰10多個省。約3,000人出席大會，包括李強、趙樂際、王滬寧、蔡奇、丁薛祥、李希及韓正。
summary.zh_hans: 纪念中国工农红军长征胜利90周年大会10月22日上午在北京人民大会堂举行，习近平出席并发表重要讲话。习近平指出「只有铭记历史，才能开创未来」，号召全党大力弘扬伟大长征精神，走好新时代的长征路。全体与会者起立，为长征途中和革命斗争中牺牲的先烈默哀。习近平强调，党的正确领导和毛泽东的核心地位是长征胜利的关键。1934年10月至1936年10月，红军长征转战10多个省。约3,000人出席大会，包括李强、赵乐际、王沪宁、蔡奇、丁薛祥、李希及韩正。

title.en: Trump envoy sparks backlash after calling Putin 'a humanitarian'
title.zh_hant: 美特使威特科夫讚普京「人道主義者」惹反彈
title.zh_hans: 美特使威特科夫赞普京「人道主义者」惹反弹

summary.en: US special envoy Steve Witkoff has sparked a political backlash after calling Russian President Vladimir Putin 'a humanitarian' during their meeting in St Petersburg, where he secured the release of American citizen Stephen Hubbard, detained in Ukraine for years. The Kremlin said Russia was ready in principle to return to Russia-US-Ukraine trilateral talks. Republican Senator Thom Tillis reacted on X with 'WTF, Steve?', while President Trump downplayed the remark and Vice-President JD Vance defended Witkoff, saying a diplomat's job is to get things done.
summary.zh_hant: 美國特使威特科夫在聖彼得堡會晤俄羅斯總統普京期間，當面讚揚對方是「人道主義者」，言論惹起政壇反彈。是次會晤成功爭取釋放在烏克蘭被拘留多年的美國公民哈伯德；克里姆林宮表示，俄方原則上準備重返美俄烏三方談判。共和黨參議員蒂利斯在社交平台X貼文「WTF, Steve?」；特朗普淡化事件，副總統萬斯則為威特科夫辯護，稱「外交官的工作就是完成任務」。
summary.zh_hans: 美国特使威特科夫在圣彼得堡会晤俄罗斯总统普京期间，当面赞扬对方是「人道主义者」，言论惹起政坛反弹。是次会晤成功争取释放在乌克兰被拘留多年的美国公民哈伯德；克里姆林宫表示，俄方原则上准备重返美俄乌三方谈判。共和党参议员蒂利斯在社交平台X贴文「WTF, Steve?」；特朗普淡化事件，副总统万斯则为威特科夫辩护，称「外交官的工作就是完成任务」。

title.en: Nine hurt as two KMB double-deckers collide in Tuen Mun
title.zh_hant: 屯門兩部九巴相撞　九人受傷送院
title.zh_hans: 屯门两部九巴相撞　九人受伤送院

summary.en: Two KMB double-decker buses collided on Ming Kum Road near King Yip House of Shan King Estate in Tuen Mun at about 8:15am on October 22, leaving nine people injured. The injured — four men and five women, including the two bus drivers — all sustained minor injuries and were sent to Tuen Mun Hospital. Police are investigating the cause of the accident.
summary.zh_hant: 10月22日早上約8時15分，兩部九巴雙層巴士在屯門鳴琴路近山景邨景業樓相撞，九人受傷。傷者包括四男五女，其中兩人為巴士車長，全部傷勢輕微，送往屯門醫院治理。警方正調查意外原因。
summary.zh_hans: 10月22日早上约8时15分，两部九巴双层巴士在屯门鸣琴路近山景邨景业楼相撞，九人受伤。伤者包括四男五女，其中两人为巴士车长，全部伤势轻微，送往屯门医院治理。警方正调查意外原因。

title.en: Wild boar wanders into Victoria Park, startling morning exercisers
title.zh_hant: 野豬清晨闖維園踱步　警持盾戒備漁護署跟進
title.zh_hans: 野猪清晨闯维园踱步　警持盾戒备渔护署跟进

summary.en: A wild boar about one metre long wandered into Victoria Park in Causeway Bay at about 7:17am on October 22, startling morning exercisers. The boar strolled and basked in the sun near a small hill in the park before leaving in the direction of Tin Hau. Police officers arrived with shields, cordoned off the area and notified the Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department to capture the animal. The department reminded the public not to feed wild animals.
summary.zh_hant: 10月22日早上約7時17分，一頭約一米長的野豬闖入銅鑼灣維多利亞公園，在園內小山丘附近踱步曬太陽，嚇親晨運市民，其後向天后方向離去。警方持盾牌到場戒備並封鎖範圍，通知漁農自然護理署派員捕捉。漁護署呼籲市民切勿餵飼野生動物。
summary.zh_hans: 10月22日早上约7时17分，一头约一米长的野猪闯入铜锣湾维多利亚公园，在园内小山丘附近踱步晒太阳，吓亲晨运市民，其后向天后方向离去。警方持盾牌到场戒备并封锁范围，通知渔农自然护理署派员捕捉。渔护署呼吁市民切勿喂饲野生动物。

title.en: Jason Chan's lost bag returned by kind-hearted taxi driver in Canada
title.zh_hant: 吳業坤加拿大漏低斜孭袋　好心的哥專程送回
title.zh_hans: 吴业坤加拿大漏低斜孭袋　好心的哥专程送回

summary.en: Singer Jason Chan has thanked a kind-hearted taxi driver in Canada who drove back specially to return a bag he left in the cab. Chan and fellow singer Cherie Kong had travelled to Canada for concerts, accompanied by Chan's wife Hamaguchi Aiko — October 20 was her 32nd birthday. When returning to Hong Kong on October 21, Chan left his black crossbody bag, containing his ID card, credit cards and passport, in a Canadian taxi. The driver returned it in person, and Chan shared the story on social media, with netizens joking he was lucky he didn't lose his wife too.
summary.zh_hant: 吳業坤與譚嘉儀早前到加拿大登台開騷，太太濱口愛子同行，10月20日更是愛子32歲生日。兩人10月21日返港，坤哥在加拿大的士上漏低整個黑色斜孭袋，內有身份證、信用卡及護照，幸獲好心的哥專程駕車回來交還。坤哥在社交平台分享經歷，網民笑指「好彩冇連老婆都漏低」。
summary.zh_hans: 吴业坤与谭嘉仪早前到加拿大登台开骚，太太滨口爱子同行，10月20日更是爱子32岁生日。两人10月21日返港，坤哥在加拿大的士上漏低整个黑色斜孭袋，内有身份证、信用卡及护照，幸获好心的哥专程驾车回来交还。坤哥在社交平台分享经历，网民笑指「好彩冇连老婆都漏低」。
